name: Staggered Segmented Nav
description: Hamburger button that opens a full-screen menu overlay revealed in four vertical segments that drop down in a staggered sequence, with large variable-weight links.
contents: Fixed hamburger toggle button that morphs into a cross
Full-screen colored menu overlay with a list of large links
behavior: Overlay clip-path is split into four columns whose bottom edges animate down one after another with GSAP
Overlay slides out of view after the segments retract
Menu link font weight increases on hover
Toggle lines rotate into a cross when open
editableByProps: Segment animation duration, ease and stagger, overlay slide timing
Link size, weights and spacing, font family

needsCodeEdit.change: Move the toggle button to the right side
